name: imageviewer
description: Image viewer with verifiable SDR/HDR color fidelity. License rules: docs/PLAN.md §5.

dependencies.$comment: No 'jpegxl': the baseline openimageio port deletes FindJXL.cmake and libjxl installs only pkg-config files, so OIIO is built without JPEG XL anyway.
dependencies.name: openimageio

dependencies.$comment: AVIF only. The overlay port (packaging/vcpkg/ports/libheif) drops the default 'hevc' feature (x265 encoder, GPL-2.0) and libde265 (HEVC decoding; HEIC goes through the operating system, D-39).
dependencies.name: libheif

dependencies.$comment: Never enable 'fastfloat' or 'threaded': both plugins are GPL-3.0.
dependencies.name: lcms

dependencies.$comment: JPEG XL read directly (D-38): the openimageio port cannot find libjxl, and its reader keeps only an animation's last frame.
dependencies.name: libjxl

dependencies.$comment: Read directly for ICC profiles and animation (WebPAnimDecoder in libwebpdemux); OpenImageIO's reader assumes sRGB.
dependencies.name: libwebp

dependencies.$comment: The long tail in the decode worker (D-38). Overlay port (packaging/vcpkg/ports/graphicsmagick): 1.3.48, no delegate libraries.
dependencies.name: graphicsmagick
